keywords: 回测区间和成本怎么设
title: Backtest run knobs: pool, window, cash, and costs
summary: qt.run(..., mode=1) merges qt.configure with run kwargs. Set asset_pool, invest_start/end, cash, costs, trade_batch_size (minimum 0.01), and allow_sell_short here—not result fields.
narrative:
Run a backtest with qt.run(op, mode=1, ...). Values from qt.configure merge with run kwargs; kwargs on the call win.

Common knobs from the backtest chapter:

- asset_pool and asset_type — which symbols to simulate.
- invest_start and invest_end — the historical window.
- invest_cash_amounts and optional invest_cash_dates — initial or staged cash.
- cost_rate_buy, cost_rate_sell, cost_min — commission-style costs.
- trade_batch_size — minimum trade unit; the documented floor is 0.01 (for example 100 for one A-share lot).
- allow_sell_short — whether short selling is allowed.
- trade_log and visual — switches that turn on trade CSV or charts; their file layout and chart reading are other cards.

Run frequency lives on the Operator / Group, not among these run kwargs. Missing local history is a data topic (starter tables and bounded refill), not a config-parameter list.

Slippage and other items the manual leaves to the configure docs are not invented here. Result fields and trade CSV columns belong on the result and trade-log cards.
python_code:
import qteasy as qt
op = qt.Operator(strategies='dma', signal_type='PT', run_freq='d')
qt.configure(asset_pool='000001.SZ', invest_start='2020-01-01', invest_end='2023-12-31')
result = qt.run(op, mode=1)
risk_notes: Ask explains knobs only. A real run needs Plan and confirmation. Do not invent undocumented parameter names.
